name: CymtX Player
author: Tiedeyez
description: CymtX in your bar: the song playing in the native CymtX music player, with a small player behind it: cover, seek bar, play/pause, next and previous, shuffle and repeat, Blend, Drift, the sleep timer, moments, CymtX's volume and the line being sung. The widget only runs the installed /usr/bin/cymtx command with a fixed list of commands (status, toggle, next, previous, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, blend, drift, sleep, moment, visual, lyrics, open); it writes no files, edits no configuration and opens no network connection. Needs the CymtX app, installed from this repository.

barWidget.description: Now playing in CymtX, with a player: cover, seek, volume, shuffle, repeat, Blend, Drift, sleep timer and lyrics
